answer: One concrete defense is a refundable economic bond: each agent must stake real collateral before it can transact. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then demands a thousand real deposits, so sybil swarms stop being cheap. Imagine agents named lotus, atlas, and yarrow each posting a stake; misbehavior gets the bond slashed, honest work earns it back with fees, and duplicate shells simply bleed capital until the attack collapses.
